newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers hold in post-Christmas quietness.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers hold in post-Christmas quietness.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotations were far apart on Thursday but held steady, supported by firm crude prices in a quiet post-Christmas market, traders said.
February Brent crude closed up 20 cents to $23.40 a barrel on Tuesday.
Most sellers were quoting between $127-$128 per tonne for 380-cst supplies with one major heard to be aggressive at $126 per tonne. Some independents were as low as $124, said a trader.
Bunker 180-cst were quoted at $132-$135 per tonne.
MDO and gas oil were steady at $231-$245, $255-$262 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
